name: HiveMind
notes: Help & FAQ: tapping a question further down no longer slides it up out of sight. The question stays in view with its answer under it.

❓ Help & FAQ, beside the version (on Home and in Settings): answers to common questions about updating, backups, voice, inspections and syncing. Search it, tap a question to open the answer. Works offline. Also a printable PDF of the answers for the club.
📜 What's new, right beside the version number (on Home and in Settings): every update's notes, newest first, to look back at after the update box is gone. Works offline.
Update now works again: the box shows the download filling up, with a percentage.
You can leave HiveMind while it downloads; the box stays, and Android asks to update as soon as you're back.
If the download stops (no signal), Try again is right there.
Inspecting a hive that's already recorded as a dead-out now says so at the top.
Inspection sections now start with a solid gold heading band, easy to spot while scrolling.
The update box always fits on the screen now, with its buttons in sight.
Settings › 🧪 Test yards: six made-up apiaries, 29 hives, covering every feature. Add them beside your hives, or erase everything and add them in one tap. They now stay put when you switch apps.
Mites: a second choice, "Not checked: not enough bees to check" (a dead-out or a tiny colony), kept apart from "Not checked today". Say it too.
Coming up on Home is grouped by apiary.
The inspection's section buttons show a › arrow when there are more to the right (tap it to see them).
The inspection shows the apiary beside the hive ("Hive 3 · Creek Yard"), and lists say which apiary when two hives share a name.
🔍 Inspect right from where a hive is shown: Home's hive list, alerts and reminders, the apiary page, and the top of each hive's page.
One number per apiary: a new hive can't share a living hive's number. Reuse a dead-out's number and the old one is renamed, e.g. "Hive 3 (dead-out Oct 2026)".
